name: Checklist
description: A dark card with a title and 3 to 5 lines. Each line comes in as you say it, its box ticks with a drawn check, and the text dims with a thin strike. A count by the title goes 0/3 to 3/3.
when: When you list steps, rules or reasons: '3 things before you post'.
needs: the lines, each with the time you say it (seconds from the start of the effect)
the position: lower third or top
the cut time where it starts
